## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) — see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] I wrote this myself or have the right to submit it; **no code, assets or docs were copied or derived from another UI library**
- [ ] Build passes with zero warnings; tests added or updated
- [ ] Visual change: before/after screenshots attached (from `tools/ArkaControls.Screenshots`), checked at 100% and 125%/150% DPI
- [ ] Public API change: discussed in an issue; XML docs, `[Category("Arka")]`, `ShouldSerialize`/`Reset` handled
- [ ] New source files carry the copyright + SPDX header
